label: preparing
what: An evening community hospitality gathering/feast in the hall at eighteen on day 1, with lanterns and 200 catered loaves. Preparations initially proceeded without the mayor knowing the occasion; he was later invited, but builder explicitly withheld the occasion's details until the gathering. Exact celebration or honoree is not established. Baker knowingly supplied paid catering and neighbour later spread invitations; neither is established as knowing the withheld details. Secretary investigated and arranged attendance, with no evidence of prior secret involvement.
